about: Vectors for the x402/exact/xrpl pairing: the xrpl and x402/exact/xrpl entry points of @integraledger/lcp. Expected values: H is SHA-256("abc") from FIPS 180-2; payer from Ed25519 entropy 01x16, destination from 02x16; 1 000 000 drops, Fee 12, Sequence 7, LastLedgerSequence 1000, computed with xrpl-py 4.1.0 on Python 3.12.3, GNU coreutils 9.4 and OpenSSL 3.0.13. The plant's blob was built with xrpl-py 4.1.0 on Python 3.11; the same script reproduces V2's and V3's blobs and hashes. Each reference names the option's payee. The read's rows are in read.

bound, reference and build's complete with V2's Payment carrying NetworkID on xrpl:1, whose id is at most 1024: rippled 3.4.1 (src/libxrpl/tx/Transactor.cpp L73-93, preflight0) refuses a transaction that carries NetworkID on a network whose id is at most 1024 (telNETWORK_ID_MAKES_TX_NON_CANONICAL, whatever its value), and on one above 1024 a transaction without it (telREQUIRES_NETWORK_ID) or with another id (telWRONG_NETWORK). Each blob is V2's Payment with NetworkID 1, then 1025, signed again by the payer, the key of Ed25519 entropy 01x16 by xrpl.org's Ed25519 Key Derivation (node:crypto's SHA-512Half): @noble/curves 2.4.0's signature over ripple-binary-codec 2.11.0's encodeForSigning, then ripple-binary-codec's encode; the same steps without NetworkID give back V2's blob byte for byte

strictEncoding.about: Blobs ripple-binary-codec 2.11.0's decode reads but that are not the canonical binary serialization of what they decode to (xrpl.org Binary Format: the signature and the transaction hash are over the canonical serialization; ripple-binary-codec's encode of the decoded JSON gives it). Each is refused.

buyer.about: The buyer gate's rows for this file's pairings, in the form of buyer.json's rows. B2 is the plant: the document advertises H, the hash of the ATR in B6's first check, and the link serves the planted ATR, that ATR with one byte changed; the gate declines hash-mismatch and never calls the signer. B6 is the pairing's bound check over the payment this file already holds: check(ATR, presented) gives H, and check(planted ATR, presented) declines signed-not-bound. Where the ATR is abc, H is its SHA-256 (FIPS 180-2 B.1) and the planted ATR is abd. SHA-256 values are GNU coreutils sha256sum, which openssl dgst -sha256 matches. Bytes are hex. A B2 input names the account, the buyer's inputs and the time (now, in seconds) its build needs. noSignedPayment names each pairing of the file that has no B6 row, and why.

multisigned.about: A multi-signed Payment is admitted: bound gives H and reference names the payer's instrument and the signed body, which is one for every quorum's copy of one payment, since the read finds a payment by its instrument and never by its hash. Each blob is the V2 Payment (1 000 000 drops, Sequence 7, LastLedgerSequence 1000) from payer r3sN…6dTC with SigningPubKey empty, Fee 48 and Signers from Ed25519 entropy 03x16, 04x16 and 05x16 (rPPdduC9MRTrXZP1J7MQyEKKEYiFigWZ6Q, rfPaNmieF15VqV752Q8qAc6ugtkKhWsA2R, rH9ESAdrFfDAZtCZGa7JiwNJfKnC6CmGFQ), multi-signed with xrpl-py 4.1.0 on Python 3.12.3 (transaction.sign with multisign=True, then transaction.multisign); each hash is xrpl-py's get_hash. The two-signer blob is the three-signer blob with the entry of the signer from 05x16 removed, byte for byte, and its hash differs: xrpl.org's Transaction Malleability page says a third party can remove a signature that the quorum does not need, and that any change gives a different hash.

read.about: The read of x402/exact/xrpl by the payer's instrument, its signer and its authority (the profile x402-exact-xrpl.md, rules 10 and 11), and the search read whole (rule 15), each row on a constructed server holding ledgers 1 to ledger + 1, ledger validated, ledger 1000 where the row names none (test/fixtures/xrpl-reader.ts): reference of the presented blob under V2's accepted, read from ledger 900 at the mark validated; account_tx answers the landed blob, or nothing where the row names none, for the payer's account alone (any other account's account_tx is empty, its account_info finds no account and its tickets are absent), validated at ledger 990 with meta.delivered_amount 1000000 drops where it succeeded, or the row's delivered, and the result given otherwise; account_info answers accountSequence, and a ticket's ledger_entry ticketPresent, at both ledgers; tx answers the landed blob only where it is the presented one. Blobs are made with ripple-binary-codec 2.11.0 and @noble/curves' Ed25519 from the keys of Ed25519 entropy 01x16 (the payer) and 02x16, by xrpl.org's Ed25519 key derivation. Each expect is the answer the profile read-status (read-status.md) and the profile x402-exact-xrpl.md (rules 9 to 15) give that ledger, read at the mark validated for the act payment.

rows.case: a ticket: V2's fields with Sequence 0 and TicketSequence 9 (TicketSequence, ripple-binary-codec 2.11.0 dist/enums/definitions.json L572), signed again by its payer; the presented blob lands, the ticket absent at both ledgers: settled on it, presented yes

a validated tec result: V2's blob lands with tecPATH_DRY, which destroys the fee, delivers nothing and consumes the sequence number (xrpl.org, Transaction Results, tec codes): the act asked about failing, transaction-failed, naming it with nothing moved

a re-signed copy: V2's fields signed with another key (Ed25519 entropy 02x16, as a regular key would sign), another hash: the read by the payer's Sequence settles on it, its signed body V2's, presented yes

a delegated payment: V2's fields with Delegate rPPdduC9MRTrXZP1J7MQyEKKEYiFigWZ6Q (Delegate, ripple-binary-codec 2.11.0 dist/enums/definitions.json L2402), signed by the delegate's key, presented and landed: settled, its signer the delegate and its authority the Delegate for the Account

an inner Batch payment: V2's fields with Flags tfInnerBatchTxn (1073741824, ripple-binary-codec 2.11.0 dist/enums/definitions.json L5320) and no signature, SigningPubKey empty, landed inside the Batch its metadata's ParentBatchID names (ParentBatchID, ripple-binary-codec 2.11.0 dist/enums/definitions.json L1512); V2 presented: settled by the payer's Sequence, its authority the parent, presented no, its signed Flags differing

a lapse: V2 presented and never landed, the validated ledger 1010 past its LastLedgerSequence 1000, the payer's Sequence not past 7, and account_tx from the issue ledger to the latest ledger read whole holding nothing: instrument-unused

another payment took the sequence number: V2's fields paying rPPdduC9MRTrXZP1J7MQyEKKEYiFigWZ6Q, not the option's payee, signed by the payer (Ed25519 entropy 01x16), landed at ledger 990; V2 presented: a charge that paid another account took the sequence number: instrument-consumed, naming it, carries other-account

the payee signed as the payer's Delegate: V2's fields with Delegate rpjfAeE3DeeHPFnN2PgGFW5YxnZFAjrEyN, the option's payee (Delegate, ripple-binary-codec 2.11.0 dist/enums/definitions.json L2402), signed with the payee's key (Ed25519 entropy 02x16), lands at ledger 990 and takes the payer's Sequence 7; V2 presented, the account's Sequence 8 at both ledgers: no agreement, the payee's own signature (read-status rules 13 and 14), and the sequence number taken by a transaction that is not the act: instrument-consumed, naming the payee's payment, carries payee-signed

a payment that signs no LastLedgerSequence: V2's fields without it, signed by its payer, presented and never landed; the validated ledger 1010, past V2's 1000, the payer's Sequence 7 at both ledgers: such a transaction has no lapse, so the value read unconsumed at the validated ledger and at the latest is pending, instrument-live (read-status rule 22; the profile x402-exact-xrpl.md, rule 12)

a ticket not yet used: the first row's blob, Sequence 0 and TicketSequence 9, presented and never landed, the validated ledger 990 below its LastLedgerSequence 1000, the payer's ticket present at both ledgers: the value read unconsumed at the validated ledger and at the latest, pending, instrument-live (read-status rule 22)

a partial payment: V2's fields with Flags tfPartialPayment (131072, ripple-binary-codec 2.11.0 dist/enums/definitions.json L5283), signed by its payer (Ed25519 entropy 01x16), lands at ledger 990 with meta.delivered_amount 400000 drops of its Amount 1000000; it presented: settled on it, presented yes, what moved the delivered amount with the flag beside it, partial, observed and not judged (read-status rule 10)
